item.title: Ten Years Ago, You Were So Scared of Such Different Things - Live Life Happy
item.description: “Ten years ago, you were so scared of such different things, but you survived them anyway. The same goes for five years ago and two years ago. Everything that has ever felt like a hurdle, you've passed through. So be afraid, identify your fears, and then allow yourself to remember that, in just a little while, this will be another thing you have overcome." - slfcare
